ctx.x: And some of the great orators past. I bought a book of speeches, but these were just great speakers up to the 60’s, and they all had that fire, you know, you go back to some of the © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

Roosevelt speeches, Churchill, Winston Churchill, the way they could speak to the guy on the lowest level, and to the person on the highest level, and they had that ability to change vocabularies, change words, and use inflections that would influence either crowd. And a musician has to do that too in a certain sense, by learning to read his audience. And sometimes your audience is deceptive.
